title: Restore schedule copy paste day controls
summary: Restores the per-day Copy Day and Paste Day buttons in the WebView Schedule 30-minute block editor and keeps pasted values as local draft state until backend preview/save.
reason: The editor redesign left only Clear Day and All Day in each day row, removing the operator shortcut for copying one day's selected 30-minute blocks into another day.
behavior_before: Each Schedule editor day row only exposed Clear Day and All Day controls, so operators had to manually reselect matching 30-minute blocks across days.
behavior_after: Each Schedule editor day row exposes Copy Day and Paste Day. Paste is disabled until a day is copied, then applies the copied block selection to the target day as an unsaved draft that still requires backend Preview Schedule before Save Schedule.
